object_description: two-story school volume with underground gymnasium
design_condition: The low school building and fully underground gymnasium are arranged with a forecourt to form a connected green space while responding to the scale of the adjacent residential area.

positive.statement: The building appears surprisingly well scaled.
The architecture with irregularly arranged concrete bulkheads is precisely and poetically formulated.
The building structure, expression, and interior design are conceived integrally and presented appealingly.
The proposal is a strong piece of architecture with great appeal in its precision.

negative.statement: The central corridor is too limited in use because it serves as the escape and access route for all classrooms.
The corridor glazing would be structurally complex if used as fire-protection glazing.
The load-bearing bulkheads prevent the room layout from being changed.
The underground gymnasium escape stairs are somewhat coincidentally located in front of the building.
The proposed hard break area is too small, and no covered break area is offered.
The remaining canton-owned area does not have the required dimensions, limiting the intended large connected space.
Even with recycled concrete, the concrete structure will hardly meet the environmental requirements.
The building-technology concept is contradictory and is not implemented in the architect's plans.
The sacred character of the interior tends to distract from the robust basic concept for small children.
The chosen typology has serious disadvantages, especially because the central corridor does not support contemporary educational work.
